* Deathmatch 4on4 event
* 2 even teams, 2 captains (the highest seeded players)
* Games every Tuesdays and Thursdays starting at 23:30cet
* Event started on the 17th of May 2022 and will end when players decide that they had enough.
* Map pool is dm2 , dm3 , e1m2 , schloss , cmt3 , ctl8
* Any more maps can be played but this is the base pool.
* At least 3 maps are played on each game.
* Each team picks 1 map and 3rd+ is random from the remaining pool.
* NO POINTS !! NO FAKERS, NO UNEVEN TEAMS, NO BULLSHIT !! JUST FUN, EVEN GAMES AND FRIENDSHIP.
* Games are usually played on dm6.uk server
